description:
## Scope correction
This is a destination-contract verification for the screenshot flow, not a mandatory standalone change to create_document. Default decision: reuse the existing Action unchanged. The absence of scope_id in its schema is an investigation observation, not proof of a missing capability; config_id and canonical parent_id may already identify the destination sufficiently. Perform this verification as part of preparing the screenshot integration in zaq-xfj.5; do not create a separate refactoring effort.

## Functional specifications and ownership
Verify that the existing validated CreateDocument Action can create a domain subfolder and upload PNG content into the exact datasource/folder selected by the reused admin picker. Trace provider, config_id, canonical parent_id and existing path semantics through lib/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/create_document.ex, DataSourceTool and Channels. Use returned canonical folder IDs rather than assuming display paths identify remote folders. Confirm the behavior against Disk and an existing remote-provider contract fixture, with actual source/config/scope identity preserved. No new scope_id parameter or production edit is required unless this exercise demonstrates a concrete failure.

## Acceptance and conditional extension gate
1. Add/reuse focused regression coverage showing folder creation and PNG upload reach the selected destination through existing inputs.
2. If the current contract works, record evidence and hand it to zaq-xfj.5; leave create_document production code/schema unchanged.
3. Only if a supported provider demonstrably needs information that the current inputs cannot express: record the failing scenario, affected provider, expected/actual destination and why canonical config/parent identity is insufficient; add a failing regression test before any fix.
4. In that evidenced case only, propose the smallest backward-compatible extension in this issue before implementation. Do not prescribe scope_id as the solution in advance. Preserve existing text/base64/folder creation and all authorization boundaries.
No filesystem-loading input, materialization-handle support, screenshot-specific parameters or general datasource refactor belongs here.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Reuse existing Action/Channels coverage and add only missing destination regressions: exact selected parent, correct datasource configuration (including multiple configs for one provider where supported), root/nested folders, scope identity, PNG binary/base64 round trip, and denied/disabled/mismatched destination behavior. Exercise validated programmatic execution, not direct run/2. Existing malformed-base64, text creation and error propagation assertions remain intact; extend them only if a proven contract fix affects them. Missing actor must never widen access. Provider stubs demonstrate contract behavior, not live remote-provider end-to-end success.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse CreateDocument -> DataSourceTool -> Channels data_source_create_file and canonical Record results with trusted actor context and NodeRouter. Folder discovery uses the existing listing operation and creation uses kind: folder. Destination comes from trusted admin configuration assembled internally by the screenshot flow, not model-selected storage parameters. A configured destination does not grant write permission or imply skip_permissions. Decision is REUSE by default; EXTEND only with the failing-provider evidence above.

## Mocking and documentation
Keep validated Action/internal dispatch boundaries real; stub external provider APIs only, with any distributed test constraint documented. Read docs/services/channels.md and the affected modules' responsibility docs. Store verification evidence and the exact working destination request shape in this issue for zaq-xfj.5. Change public Action/Channels docs only if an evidenced extension actually changes their contract; otherwise no production documentation change is needed here.

## Execution constraints and policies
Planning only; do not mark complete without implementation evidence. Future implementation uses a new branch in the current worktree, not another worktree; do not commit/push without authorization. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Read each affected module @moduledoc and relevant service owner before editing. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle rather than inventing alternate gates. Preserve existing assertions. New feature E2E authoring is deferred until the separate human approval issue closes.
title: [zaq-xfj.4] Verify screenshot destination with existing create_document contract
